I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: "Thanks, Pree, noted that you're out from 2 pm today. I don't need anything from you right now. If something comes up that needs you, I'll ping you before 2."

She hadn't asked for anything, so this was only an acknowledgment. I didn't look anything up and didn't need approval for anything.
